card.name: Parenthesis before an acronym starting with I
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis after a full organization or device name whose acronym starts with I, such as ILO, IOP, IUS or IUD. Also the unit 'mg' before the word Iodine in contrast-agent strengths.

modes.label: Acronym opener
modes.description: The '(' right after a spelled-out name, just before an I-initial abbreviation.

modes.label: mg before Iodine
modes.description: The unit 'mg' in contrast-agent strengths, just before the word Iodine.
modes.example: OMNIPAQUE injection 300<< mg>> iodine/mL and OMNIPAQUE

card.writes: It pushes the model to output a capital I, as the start of an acronym or of the word Iodine.
card.plain: It spots the point where an abbreviation starting with I is about to be given, or where 'Iodine' follows mg.
